prompt: A mail to compliance@example.test contains a raw SSN. Which control is supposed to stop that?
options: Data guard / DLP on the payload
asserts: you can pick the control that inspects payload content, not the destination
pass_message: Right. The destination is in-policy. The payload is restricted. That is DLP.
fail_message: example.test is an allowed domain. Allow-list and HITL do not classify SSNs.
